title: The Hollow Protocol
author: Odile Okonkwo
blurb: Gideon Crane, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
